replies.author: MLGtino
replies.body:
Well since you asked:

- More detail
- Less void
- Trash the color palette
- Map doesn't look symmetrical
- Monuments need more strategical placing
- More color, the map needs to pop
- Doesn't look unique
- Designs are very basic and need a little more work
- The lava is a nono
- When taking screenshots use higher render distances instead of anything small than 4. On small render distances it's difficult for both you and us to calculate the relative size of the map. It doesn't matter if it lags, it won't show in the screenshot. 
- I don't agree with the use of the fences
- I can't locate the iron supply, and if it is below those 4 blocks then you need to find another place to put it, increase the size of the island, or put more islands around it. Essentially that's because the area is going to be chaotic with people going for armor whilst others are rushing the mid for diamonds or the opposing team's monuments.
